'''Hriin''' was a [[City/Legends|town]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Auratera/Legends|Auratera]].

==History==
Located 3,000 [[Meter/Legends|kilometers]] from [[Acablas/Legends|Acablas]], Hriin was constructed on the opposite side of the [[Erkeere Ridge/Legends|Erkeere Ridge]] from the [[Vergence/Legends|vergence]]. Largely populated by [[Human/Legends|Humans]] and [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'leks]], Hriin was situated on bluffs high above the [[Hriin River]]'s north bank. A fishing community, the town had no [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] but was equipped with landing pads for [[Airspeeder/Legends|airspeeders]]. The water from the river powered the city's generators, which were prone to malfunction. The city government, overseen by an elected chancellor, was responsible for the operation of the town and its industry.By the time of the reign of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], Hriin was the closest settlement to Acablas that was still populated.<ref name="NoP" />
